args.question: Acme Supplies (V-712) has two approved, unpaid invoices, and I can't tell from the records which one is "the one that's due": INV-44255 for $7,468.88, due 2026-11-04, and INV-50902 for $2,059.63, due 2026-11-25. I have not sent any payment yet.

trace.final:

Acme had two approved invoices, and the records didn't say which one was due. I asked you, and you confirmed INV-44255 (due 2026-11-04). I sent the payment once, with an idempotency key so it could not be executed twice.

I did not touch the other approved invoice, INV-50902 ($2,059.63, due 2026-11-25), or the draft INV-53481 ($3,106.06), which is still awaiting approval.
